subject: Wire kill_delegation approval gating
description:
In `capo/tools/delegations.py`, change `kill_delegation` so that ALL invocations spawn the approval workflow with `action_kind='kill_delegation'` and `action_payload={'delegation_id': ..., 'reason': ...}`. On approve, send SIGTERM to the PID, mark row `killed`, persist reason, notify user.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Every `kill_delegation(delegation_id, reason)` triggers approval before any side effect.
- [ ] On approve: SIGTERM to the row's PID; if PID gone, mark `killed` and proceed.
- [ ] On deny: no signal; tool returns "denied"; delegation continues.
- [ ] On expired: no signal; tool returns "expired"; delegation continues.
- [ ] Approval question includes the delegation's goal (read from `brief_json`) and runtime so the user has context.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `kill_delegation` on already-completed delegation: no approval needed; tool returns "already terminal".
- [ ] Subprocess does not exit within graceful window after SIGTERM: send SIGKILL, log escalation.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: kill flow → approval question → approve → row `killed`, subprocess terminated
• Integration: kill flow with deny → row stays `running`
• Integration: kill on already-completed → no approval; tool returns "already terminal"

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.5, 5.8, 9.4
